intermediate.name: Alt del Purgatori
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Alt del Purgatori (18.3 km)

story: Stage 2 of the Volta Ciclista a Catalunya saw a five-rider breakaway, with Baptiste Veistroffer and Liam Slock holding on longest. Slock went solo inside the final 3 km but was caught at the flamme rouge. Magnus Cort sprinted to victory ahead of Noa Isidore and Francesco Busatto.
